rows.name: W-4 · Run
rows.why: One screen for each level. Each row is one step run, oldest at the top. A child flow ▸ is one row that opens its own level. A restart ↺ is a chip, and the new pass continues in the same lane. The card on top shows who acts now.

rows.name: W-5 · Step run
rows.why: A tap on a row or a chip opens a sheet over the dimmed level. A step run shows its result, input, why it ran and where it went. A child flow shows its passes and exits. A restart chip shows its reason, its limit and what step 1 sees.
